title: The expected short rate in the Vasicek model
caption: Starting at 2% with speed a = 0.5 and long-run level b = 4%, the expected rate rises at first by a(b − r) = 1% a year and then flattens towards 4%.
alt: A curve rising from 2% and flattening towards the dashed 4% level.
description: The drift is a(b − r) = 0.5 × (0.04 − 0.02) = 0.01 per year.
So the expected rate climbs at 1% a year at first.
As r nears b the pull weakens: E[r] → 4%.

checks.name: the initial slope is a(b − r) = 0.01 a year
